stories.title: Ukrainian strikes kill one, injure eight civilians in Lugansk People’s Republic
stories.summary: Civilian, municipal and industrial infrastructure facilities were damaged in Stakhanov, Rubezhnoye, Rovenky and Alchevsk
article_sentences: LUGANSK, August 21.

The Ukrainian armed forces launched strikes on municipalities in the Lugansk People’s Republic (LPR), killing one civilian and injuring eight others over the past day, Leonid Pasechnik, the republic’s head, reported on Telegram.
"The enemy has attacked the republic again.
Unfortunately, one person was killed and eight were injured, including a minor," he wrote.
According to the regional head, a woman was killed and two other civilians were wounded in the Svatovo district as a result of attacks by the Ukrainian armed forces.
In Severodonetsk, three people, including a child, were injured in an attack on a private home.
In the Slavyanoserbsky district, a Ukrainian drone struck a locomotive, injuring the assistant engine driver.
In Rubezhnoye and Kremennaya, two men were injured as a result of Ukrainian strikes.
Over the past 24 hours, the Ukrainian armed forces also struck vehicles in Lugansk and Kirovsk.

Civilian, municipal, and industrial infrastructure facilities were damaged in Stakhanov, Rubezhnoye, Rovenky, and Alchevsk, as well as in the Stanichno-Lugansky, Lutuginsky, Troitsky, and Novopskovsky municipal districts.
In four municipalities of the republic, falling debris caused fires in open areas.
"Local authorities and emergency response services are working to address the consequences of the enemy attacks.

stories.title: Future world order to be a world of Asia, BRICS — Brazilian politician
stories.summary: Jose Dirceu also highlighted shifts in US foreign policy
article_sentences: RIO DE JANEIRO, August 21.

The emerging multipolar global order is increasingly centered around Asia and the BRICS nations, despite ongoing efforts by the United States to restore its dominance in the Western Hemisphere, Jose Dirceu, a close confidant of Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, has said in an interview with TASS.
"I firmly believe that the transformations we've witnessed over the past 25 years signal the dawn of a new world order.
I often emphasize that this new era will be defined by Asia and BRICS.
Our bloc - comprising Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa - has grown significantly, exemplified by the establishment of the New Development Bank," Dirceu stated.
He also highlighted shifts in US foreign policy.
"There have been profound changes - if not always in substance, then certainly in form.
Under President Donald Trump, the United States essentially revived the Monroe Doctrine, which continues to influence global dynamics, especially in Latin America and Brazil.
In this new geopolitical landscape, Brazil is poised to play a pivotal role," he remarked.
Dirceu also pointed out that Brazil is once again encountering interference from Washington in its elections and domestic institutions.
